label: Language-game internality
resolution: The new modest analyst practice sense concerns activity-specific competent moves and permits shared evidence. Existing Wittgensteinian fideism records distinguish the sharp WF-N cut-off from early-Phillips nonreference and late-Phillips/minimalist variants. The modest position is not identified with any source-attributed variant and implies neither insulation from outside criticism nor God-name nonreference. No weak-to-strong or historical identity relation is registered.
